To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the factors causing customer churn in the telecom industry are categorized into 5 broad categories: customer service and support, network and service related factors, customer satisfaction, customer value and customer relationship.

the factors causing telecom customer churn can be categorized as customer related, service related, and company related factors and the factors causing telecom customers churn are different from other industry churn factors.

customer satisfaction is the most important factor in the telecom churn model and the other most important factors are customer loyalty, customer retention, customer acquisition, customer service, and customer relationship management.
